unit.why: A pastoral letter from R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov to the Munkacs hasidim during an epidemic. It forbids recourse to doctors and argues the point homiletically from verses, Rashi, Maimonides and the Tikkunim. It then prescribes Psalms, charity and joy against melancholy. The only event mentioned is a one-line report of a heavenly disclosure, which is not a narrative.
